{
  "headline": "FOURIER met its primary composite endpoint with evolocumab, confirming a robust success consistent with the calculator's prediction of a 24.9% relative risk reduction and 100% power.",
  "summary": "The FOURIER trial randomized 27,564 patients with established cardiovascular disease and LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL on statin therapy to evolocumab or placebo. The trial planned 1,630 primary endpoint events over a median follow-up of 26 months and was not stopped early. Phase 3 data (LAPLACE-2) showed a ~63% placebo-adjusted LDL-C reduction with evolocumab. The calculator translated this biomarker effect into an expected hazard ratio of 0.751 (24.9% RRR) with 100% power, well below the minimum detectable effect of HR 0.87 at 80% power. The press release confirmed that Repatha significantly reduced the risk of cardiovascular events, with no new safety issues observed. Genetic evidence supports a causal role of PCSK9-mediated LDL-C lowering in coronary heart disease. Confidence in the success classification is high.",

    "27,564 patients randomized (source: Rationale and design of the Further cardiovascular OUtcomes Research with PCSK9 Inhibition in subjects with Elevated Risk trial.; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01764633 FOURIER)",
